headline: Third quiet day; the board drifts by hundredths
body: A third quiet day in a row, with nothing new scored. With no new events, the only movement came from older stories fading: Protector God, Gatekeeper and the endings that need powerful AI each lost 0.02, and the world factors shifted by similarly tiny amounts. Horizon Balance stays at +2.11.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Gatekeeper -0.02.
